Onboarding composition — Wave 3: the last mile to the Kinsta/Vercel bar

Living strategy Paper. Opened at Strategize (surveying). Every later phase appends: Digest folds the survey + verify plan, Decide folds decisions + the wave plan, Review closes the debrief. If you are reading this mid-wave, the "Where the wave stands" line tells you exactly where we are.

Where the wave stands

COMPLETE — reviewed, grade A-. All five slices built, gated GREEN on their -r branches, and reviewed with ZERO reviewer fixes needed. Ledger honest (all in_progress, merge-gated criteria open for the lead). The full debrief is the last section of this Paper. Awaiting lead merge (the two Elixir slices after the Elixir Test CI gate).

The wish (verbatim intent)

Clear the buildable backlog the wave-2 review filed under the epic — finish the ONE-transaction ONE-receipt onboarding to the Kinsta/Vercel bar. Wave 2 landed and merged (instance-ID identity core + BOM tolerance, team-aware CLI, whoami/doctor receipt spine — all on origin/main, confirmed). The remaining buildable children (skip the human/ops-gated onb-backlog-cloud-url-fleet-backfill):

  1. onb-backlog-doctor-prefer-local-serverentry — point bp doctor --onboarding at the local ServerEntry.InstanceID/Aliases that wave-2 landed, instead of a live fleet fetch (faster, offline-honest).
  2. onb-backlog-capabilities-base-url-alias — resolve the capabilities base-URL against the ServerEntry aliases / caller Host.
  3. onb-backlog-studio-verify-persistence — persist the Studio verify state onto the fleet row.
  4. onb-backlog-noninteractive-device-flow — a non-interactive device-link login path (--device-start / --device-poll).
  5. onb-backlog-installer-path-postcondition — assert the installer's PATH postcondition (clean-shell resolution).

Each slice needs a real behavioral proof — a genuine first-time / offline / non-interactive flow. Decide triages ready vs blocked and cuts the wave file-disjoint.

Grounding facts (verified against origin/main this session)

  • Wave 2 is MERGED. connectToBarkpark(... res.InstanceID, res.Team) lives at cloud12_cmd.go:358; doctor_onboarding.go exists with the full receipt spine; the three wave-2 slice tasks show done in the ledger. The stranded-branch risk from wave 1/2 is resolved.
  • The doctor still round-trips the fleet. doctor_onboarding.go:71 returns ListAllBarkparks(cloudCtx()); onboardingInstance (line 338) reads that cross-team fleet as authoritative — the exact inefficiency slice 1 kills. The whoami half already reads local ServerEntry (wave-2 review fix); only the doctor path lags.
  • Device login is one blocking process. runDeviceLoginFlow (login_device.go:91) does DeviceStart then a synchronous poll; DeviceStartResp already carries the fields a split needs.
  • Installer only string-checks PATH. install-cli.sh:141 is a case ":${PATH}:" membership test that merely warns — no clean-shell confirmation, no rc-file patch, no GUI-agent reload caveat.

Direction — the finished experience

The Kinsta/Vercel bar is not "the verbs exist." It is: a first-time user, possibly offline, possibly scripting, gets one honest receipt every time and the tooling never lies about what it knows. Wave 2 built the receipt; Wave 3 makes the receipt trustworthy at the edges — offline, non-interactive, freshly-installed, custom-hostname. This is the polish that separates "works on my machine" from "works for a stranger on Windows."

The through-line for all five slices: tell the truth with the cheapest source that is correct. Prefer local config over a network round-trip (slice 1). Reflect the host the caller actually used, not a boot-time scalar (slice 2). Make a fire-and-forget probe leave a durable, readable fact (slice 3). Let a script drive login without a human-blocked 15-minute poll (slice 4). Confirm bp actually resolves rather than asserting it does (slice 5).

Triage lean (Decide finalizes)

  • READY — Go/scripts, fast gate, fully file-disjoint from the two concurrent cycles and from each other: slice 1 (doctor-prefer-local, doctor_onboarding.go), slice 4 (device-flow split, login_device.go + cloud12_cmd.go + client.go), slice 5 (installer, scripts/install-cli.sh + .ps1). Ship these with confidence.
  • SCRUTINIZE — genuinely buildable but Elixir-gated and heavier; Decide must confirm readiness: slice 2 (capabilities base_url, api/lib/barkpark/plugins/capabilities.ex + controller + api router.ex — watch the Sobelow-baseline line-shift gotcha on router.ex, and audit who consumes base_url from the envelope before changing its shape) and slice 3 (studio-verify persistence, a new cloud/priv/repo/migrations file + verify.ex UPDATE + cloud router + a Go fleet-row surface). Both wait for the Elixir Test CI gate. Neither touches api/lib/barkpark/search/** (cloud-build W7) or api/test/** isolation (Felix) — collision surface is low but non-zero via router.ex churn and the Go fleet-row struct.

Collision watch among the five

Slice 1 (doctor reads ListAllBarkparks) and slice 3 (adds a field to the Go fleet-row struct / cloudclient.Barkpark) may both touch the fleet-row Go type. Slice 4 owns cloud12_cmd.go; slice 1 does not. Decide should sequence or file-partition slice 1 vs slice 3 on the fleet-row struct, and confirm slice 4's cloud12_cmd.go edits don't overlap slice 1.

Survey plan (every question + why)

Fifteen broad scouts. Width is cheap now; Digest distills.

  1. doctor-seam — Map onboardingInstance/buildOnboardingReceipt and the ListAllBarkparks call: what a local-first path needs, how localInstance (whoami) already does it, existing tests. Why: slice 1's exact edit + its offline test shape.
  2. serverentry-shape — Confirm ServerEntry.InstanceID/Aliases/Team on origin/main config.go, how they're populated, and whether an offline read needs no cloud session. Why: slice 1 depends on this being real and network-free.
  3. device-flow — Map runDeviceLoginFlow, DeviceStart/poll, DeviceStartResp, the login command wiring in cloud12_cmd.go, and existing login flags/json conventions. Why: how --device-start/--device-poll slot in cleanly.
  4. installer — Map install-cli.sh (line 141 area) + install-cli.ps1: rc-file detection, how to spawn a clean child shell to confirm resolution, any existing installer test harness. Why: slice 5's postcondition + its behavioral proof.
  5. capabilities-baseurl — Map capabilities.ex default_server/base_url, where PHX_HOST feeds it, the controller's access to request Host, and registry.ex:2299 public_base prior art. Why: slice 2's fix shape (request-derived vs envelope-restructure).
  6. baseurl-consumers — Who reads base_url from the capabilities envelope (JS SDK, Go CLI, TUI)? Would restructuring to instance-id+aliases break them? Why: shape change is a contract change — must not break consumers.
  7. verify-persistence — Map verify.ex run_verify/3, the agent_event append, the barkparks schema + all migrations (is there a last_verified_at?), and where the fleet-list query serializes rows. Why: slice 3's migration-vs-join decision.
  8. fleet-row-go — Where does Go read/serialize the fleet row (cloudclient.Barkpark, bp barkparks, bp cloud status)? Which fields exist, and where would a studio_status/last_verified_at surface. Why: slice 3's Go half + collision with slice 1.
  9. file-disjoint-map — Enumerate the EXACT file set each of the 5 slices touches; overlaps among them AND against cloud-build W7 (api/lib/barkpark/search/**, search_controller.ex) and Felix (api/test/**). Why: Decide cuts the wave file-disjoint.
  10. go-test-patterns — How do CLI tests mock the cloud client / config / manifest? Show an existing offline / no-fleet-client test to copy for slice 1 and the two-step device test for slice 4. Why: every slice needs a genuine behavioral proof.
  11. elixir-gate-risk — For slices 2 & 3: the Sobelow stale-baseline gotcha on router.ex line-shift, the Elixir Test gate, migration numbering/mechanics on the cloud DB, and whether adding a column is safe on the live fleet. Why: is the SCRUTINIZE pair truly ready or blocked?
  12. audit-acceptance — Pull BP-ONB-09/10/13 (+ D4) from the audit paper barkpark-onboarding-painpoint-audit-2026-07-13 and the regression matrix: what "behavioral proof" each expects. Why: acceptance criteria must cite the audit's own bar.
  13. prior-art-papers — Search bp papers/tasks for the wave-2 paper, any device-flow / installer / capabilities-host prior attempts, and the whoami-receipt design. Why: don't rebuild; compose the merged primitive.
  14. studio-card — Is there a Studio card/UI that would surface a persisted verify state (lead hinted "maybe a Studio card")? Does slice 3 need a read surface or just the fleet json? Why: scope slice 3's surface honestly.
  15. whoami-receipt-spine — Current shape of the whoami receipt tail (builtins.go + doctor_onboarding.go payload): fields, json keys, how doctor composes over whoami. Why: slice 1 must align doctor's local-first read with the spine; no second receipt.

Tasks this wave drives

onb-backlog-doctor-prefer-local-serverentry, onb-backlog-capabilities-base-url-alias, onb-backlog-studio-verify-persistence, onb-backlog-noninteractive-device-flow, onb-backlog-installer-path-postcondition — all children of onboarding-composition-epic. Human/ops-gated onb-backlog-cloud-url-fleet-backfill stays OUT.

Constraints (lead notes)

All phases Opus (Fable exhausted) — never Fable/Haiku. Builders branch from origin/main in isolated worktrees, CC=/usr/bin/clang, isolated MIX_TEST_PARTITION DB (never drop shared barkpark_test), COMMIT to worktree branch but do NOT push — steward pushes + PRs. Known flake NOT ours: deploy_runner_test.exs:581 (task-32ee49492917906d). Any charter update lands via clean-extract PR, never local main.

Digest — survey folded, verify fleet in flight (2026-07-16)

15 surveyors reported. Baseline PROVEN clean: go build/vet/test ./internal/cli/... is green on origin/main tip (6f40ffcc6) — ok internal/cli 14.880s, vet clean — but ONLY with CC=/usr/bin/clang exported for the whole chain. The lead's CC=clang go build && go vet && go test sets CC on build alone; vet/test then invoke cgo through the cc Claude-wrapper alias and fail with unknown option '-E'. Builders MUST export CC=/usr/bin/clang.

What is now established

  • Slice 1 (doctor prefer-local) is a reorder, not new plumbing. onboardingInstance (doctor_onboarding.go:338-355) is fleet-first with a bare {URL,Source:"active-server"} fallback that never reads local; the network-free localInstance (258-278) already does the right thing and is what whoami uses. Footprint = doctor_onboarding.go (+ test) ONLY — it does NOT edit config.go or client.go.
  • Slice 2 (capabilities base_url) — five surveyors converge: this is a VALUE fix, NOT an envelope restructure. manifest/2 already accepts a :server override (capabilities.ex:73-74,183); the controller derives base_url from conn.scheme/host/port exactly like ticket_keys_controller.ex:141-146 and passes it through. Zero schema change. Likely NO router.ex touch.
  • Slice 3 (studio-verify-persistence) — no persistence exists today; run_verify/3 lives in cloud/.../web/router.ex:1615 (NOT verify.ex) and only appends a fire-and-forget agent_event. The Studio card ALREADY EXISTS and is live (app.js C8, #instance-verify). Slice 3 = migration adding a cached column + stamp in run_verify + barkpark_json + Go struct — NO new UI. Flat-column matches the update_state/health_status idiom.
  • Slice 4 (device flow) — client primitives (DeviceStart/DevicePoll, DeviceStartResp) already exist; gap is the CLI split. Poll loop is INLINE in runDeviceLoginFlow (login_device.go:91-158) and must be extracted. bp login is flag-routed (no sub-verbs). Rich test scaffolding exists (newDeviceServer, deviceServer hit counters).
  • Slice 5 (installer) — genuine build: NO shell-rc detection exists anywhere. fetch-prebuilt.test.sh is the hermetic harness template. Prior work exists on origin/feat/indx-barkpark-phase0-installer-fixes (released claim worker-1-team410) — MUST reconcile before re-filing.

Corrections to the strategic direction (Decide must absorb)

  1. Collision watch is wrong. Direction flagged 1∩3 on the fleet-row Go struct. Slice 1 only READS cloudclient.Barkpark via ListAllBarkparks and its real fix removes even that. The genuine internal overlap is 3∩4 on internal/cloudclient/client.go (struct-field-add vs device-flow methods — disjoint regions; sequence, don't block).
  2. Slice 2 is a value fix, not "reshaping the envelope." Adding any field inside the capabilities server object is DANGEROUS: manifest.go:125 DisallowUnknownFields() + schema additionalProperties:false means an unmatched field = whole-CLI Parse outage for every older bp against that server. And run.go:1305-1315 isProd() substring-matches base_url for a real hostname — it must stay a URL string. Derive-the-value, don't restructure.
  3. Slice 3 file pointer is off by one module: run_verify/3 is in cloud/.../web/router.ex, not verify.ex.
  4. No new Studio card. The console verify card is already built; scope-creeping a LiveView/HEEx surface violates wire-don't-rebuild.

Coverage map — checked & FOUND

  • doctor_onboarding.go onboardingInstance/localInstance split, buildOnboardingReceipt wiring — FOUND, matches direction.
  • config.go ServerEntry.InstanceID/Aliases/Team + FindServer (network-free read) — FOUND, wave-2 landed.
  • capabilities.ex default_server/base_url scalar + manifest/2 :server override; ticket_keys_controller.ex conn-derived base_url precedent — FOUND.
  • manifest.go Server.BaseURL, DisallowUnknownFields, isProd() consumer; js/** + web/** = ZERO manifest consumers — FOUND.
  • cloud router.ex run_verify/3 fire-and-forget; agent_event append-only schema; barkpark_json has no verify field — FOUND.
  • login_device.go inline poll loop; cloudclient DeviceStart/DevicePoll primitives; login_device_test.go fixtures — FOUND.
  • install-cli.sh:141 string-membership check; install-cli.ps1 registry write; fetch-prebuilt.test.sh harness — FOUND.
  • Go CLI baseline gate GREEN (PROVEN this digest).

Coverage map — checked & NOT FOUND (decisions-in-waiting / unreached corners)

  • No verify/studio_status column anywhere in cloud migrations or the Ecto schema, and no field on cloudclient.Barkpark — slice 3 is greenfield; Decide must PICK column name(s) (e.g. studio_verified_at + studio_verify_ok).
  • No installer test harness in CI or scripts/; cli-release.yml never runs the installer. Builder invents one.
  • No --device-start/--device-poll flags in the login parser today — genuinely new surface. Poll-loop extraction is unwritten.
  • UNREACHED: how to PROVE slice 3 without a DB/boot. No surveyor established a targeted-test path for the migration+UPDATE (Elixir gate is the real blocker, but local proof is DB-less). Verify fleet targets this.
  • UNREACHED: X-Forwarded-Host / Caddy trust for slice 2 — is conn.host already correct behind the proxy, or is forwarded-header handling needed? Not settled.
  • UNREACHED: reconciliation of origin/feat/indx-barkpark-phase0-installer-fixes — what did the prior installer attempt land; does it partially satisfy slice 5?
  • UNREACHED: TestOnboardingReceiptShape currently asserts Source=="cloud-fleet" — will slice 1's local-first flip break it? Needs a run.

Decide — decisions final, 6 slices in flight (2026-07-16)

Six verifiers ran the load-bearing proofs; every one came back with actually-run output, and the direction was corrected on four points. All five slices are buildable this wave. The through-line holds: tell the truth with the cheapest source that is correct.

Verification results — proven / refuted (proof lines quoted)

  • Slice 1 (v1-slice1-testshape) — PROVEN, design pinned to MERGE not pure-local. localInstance-first with a fleet fallback when local.ID=="" passes the whole suite incl. TestOnboardingReceiptShape: ok internal/cli 23.264s. The literal charter reading (delete the fleet path) was refuted — pure-local FAILS: instance = &{ID: … Source:local}, want id inst-123 team Gyldendal source cloud-fleet. onbInstance.Source is a pure JSON provenance tag: grep found it read by only the two test assertions, never by instanceDetail — the human receipt renders identically regardless.
  • Slice 2 (v2-slice2-valuefix) — PROVEN as a VALUE fix, envelope restructure refuted as dangerous. Controller derives base_url from conn.scheme/host + x-forwarded-proto/port (mirroring ticket_keys_controller.ex:141-146) and passes it through the existing manifest/2 :server override: 65 tests, 0 failures, with the probe asserting server.base_url=="https://gyldendal.barkpark.cloud" AND Map.keys(server) unchanged. A reshape is a whole-CLI outage risk: manifest.go:125 DisallowUnknownFields() + schema additionalProperties:false, and run.go:1310 isProd() substring-matches base_url so it must stay a URL string. The get("/capabilities") route already exists at router.ex:1503 → no router.ex touch → the Sobelow line-shift and the Felix-CSP (task-0fc9d55c) collision both dissolve.
  • Slice 3 (v3-slice3-proofpath) — PROVEN, the DB-less-only premise is FALSE. mix test runs locally against Postgres (the OOM is phx.server-only): registry_update_status_test 3/0, verify_test 18/0, migrations apply. The 3∩4 partition is confirmed disjoint (append at the Barkpark struct tail → BUILD_EXIT=0 VET_EXIT=0). run_verify/3 lives at router.ex:1615 (NOT verify.ex, which is a pure prober); columns are greenfield; the console verify card (#instance-verify C8) is already live (app.js 400/400) — no new Studio card, backend-only.
  • Slice 4 (v4-slice4-devicesplit) — PROVEN, filed criterion REWRITTEN to one-shot. The reusable primitive is the single-poll step (devicePollStep), not the loop; slow_down interval-widening + heartbeat dots stay in the loop caller (else TestDeviceLoginSlowDownBacksOff breaks). Slice 4 needs no internal/cloudclient/client.go change — DeviceStart/DevicePoll/DeviceStartResp already exist. The originally-filed criterion said "--device-poll poll until authorized" (the BLOCKING design that still contains the 15-min loop); it was rewritten to one-shot: single DevicePoll → emit {status} → exit, script owns the cadence.
  • Slice 5 (v5-slice5-reconcile) — PROVEN greenfield, no reconciliation. origin/feat/indx-barkpark-phase0-installer-fixes is a false name-match (PR #116 CLOSED, a server bootstrap; it doesn't even contain scripts/install-cli.sh). The prior claim released at epoch 2 with zero delivered work. Clean-shell proof shape confirmed experimentally: an in-process export PATH makes command -v bp succeed in-process but a fresh shell after exit returns exit=1 — only a spawned child (bash -lc) proves the real postcondition. fetch-prebuilt.test.sh (14/14 PASS) is the reusable hermetic template.
  • Disjointness (v6-disjoint-final) — PROVEN. All five slices are file-disjoint from cloud-build W7's api/lib/barkpark/search/** and from Felix pristine's api/test/**; migrations are in sync (latest 20260715120000, so slice-3's must be 20260716…); all five tasks are open and claimable.

Coverage — checked & NOT FOUND (decisions that rested on absence): no renderer branches on onbInstance.Source (only 2 test reads); no verified_at/verify_reachable column exists anywhere (greenfield); the JS SDK does not consume the manifest server.base_url (nextjs core.ts:77 uses projectUrl) so no SDK contract to protect; no scripts/install-cli.test.sh exists yet (builder writes it).

Decisions (each mirrors a charter D15–D22)

  • D15 — Slice 1 is a MERGE reorder, not pure-local. Why: pure-local drops fleet-resolution coverage and forces a test rewrite; the merge keeps TestOnboardingReceiptShape green and is still offline in the common case (stamped local ID → fleet never dialed).
  • D16 — Slice 2 is a per-request VALUE fix through the existing :server override; no envelope reshape, no router.ex touch. Why: strict wire decode on both ends + isProd substring make any new server field a CLI-outage risk; the value fix is proven safe (65 green) and dissolves the Sobelow/Felix-CSP worry.
  • D17 — Slice 3 persists FLAT columns (last_verified_at :utc_datetime_usec + verify_reachable :boolean) in run_verify/3 via a narrow verify_changeset/2 + Registry.record_verify_result/2, surfaced in barkpark_json/3 only + Go struct tail (pointer *bool); no new Studio card. Why: flat matches the update_state idiom, local Postgres gives a full DataCase proof, the console card is already live.
  • D18 — Slice 4 is ONE-SHOT (--device-start emits+exits; --device-poll does one poll and exits), extracting a shared devicePollStep, no client.go change. Why: a blocking --device-poll still hides the 15-min loop, failing the "no blocking poll" constraint; the script must own the cadence.
  • D19 — Slice 5 is greenfield: real clean-shell (child bash -lc / BASH_ENV) resolution check + rc-file patch + GUI-agent stale-PATH caveat on both installers + a new hermetic install-cli.test.sh templated on fetch-prebuilt.test.sh. Why: the string-membership check is misleading and an in-process PATH export dies with the process.
  • D20 — Collision map corrected: the flagged 1∩3 is refuted (slice 1 = doctor_onboarding.go only); slice 4 needs no client.go, so 3∩4 also dissolves. All five are mutually file-disjoint and disjoint from both concurrent cycles.
  • D21 — Triage: 1/4/5 READY (pure Go/scripts, fast gate); 2/3 SCRUTINIZE (Elixir-gated, wait for the Elixir Test CI gate). Skip the human/ops-gated onb-backlog-cloud-url-fleet-backfill.
  • D22 — All phases Opus (Fable exhausted). Builders branch off origin/main in isolated worktrees, CC=/usr/bin/clang, isolated MIX_TEST_PARTITION DB; commit to worktree branch, steward pushes + PRs. Known pre-existing flake deploy_runner_test.exs:581 — do not chase.

Cross-slice coherence

All five slices are mutually file-disjoint (confirmed by diff-stat) and disjoint from the concurrent cloud-build W7 / Felix cycles — the lead merges each independently; no integration branch is needed. No duplicated helpers, one consistent receipt vocabulary. The two Elixir slices touch different trees (api/ vs cloud/) so they never collide.

What stalled

Nothing built stalled — all five are gate-green and delivered. What is deliberately NOT in this wave: the human/ops-gated onb-backlog-cloud-url-fleet-backfill (skipped per D21), and the newly-surfaced edges filed as backlog (below).

Ledger audit outcome

Exemplary hygiene: all 5 slice tasks are honestly in_progress, correctly parented to onboarding-composition-epic, wave_paper-linked, and every criterion is met:true with file:line/run evidence EXCEPT the final merge-gated "PR merged" criterion, correctly left OPEN for the lead. No out-of-wave task was touched. Reviewer ledger fixes: (1) published the builder-filed draft onb-backlog-doctor-local-alias-shadow-reconcile (the stale-local-alias-shadow follow-up to slice 1's D15 unconditional-local-trust — its go-cli tag rationale was 15 chars, under the publish wall's 20-char floor; lengthened, main_tag derived, then published); (2) stamped the epic wave_status = "wave: complete — grade A-" and linked wave_paper (both were unset).

Grade — A-

Every slice is correct, protective-tested, formatted, and finishes the wish's edge-hardening (offline / non-interactive / freshly-installed / custom-hostname) exactly as the direction demanded — "tell the truth with the cheapest source that is correct" is honored in all five. What holds it just under A, honestly: (a) the PowerShell installer path is unverified at runtime (no pwsh on the test host — structural grep only), and (b) slice 1's D15 trusts a stamped local id unconditionally, so a fleet-side canonical rename can shadow stale local aliases. Neither is a defect in what ships — both are known, disclosed edges, and (b) is already filed + published as a follow-up. This is polished, honest, edge-hardening work.

What the next wave should take

Lead first: merge the 5 slices (the three Go/script slices on their own gate; the two Elixir slices AFTER the Elixir Test CI gate goes green) and close each task's merge-gated criterion. Then the backlog frontier: onb-backlog-doctor-local-alias-shadow-reconcile (stale-alias reconcile), onb-backlog-isprod-custom-host-write-confirm (server-authoritative is-prod for the destructive-write confirm), and the wave-2 backlog→wave candidates — BP-ONB-07 command-discovery classification, BP-ONB-09 CLI fleet-health decompose, BP-ONB-12 onramp + 14 BOM/tracker safety. onb-backlog-cloud-url-fleet-backfill stays human/ops-gated. The epic endgame is unchanged: a live end-to-end proof of the sub-5-minute Windows journey against a real Cloud instance.
